how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_103.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.b: The ability can be toggled on/off when used.
The ability activates instantly after some time of cyclical use. The outcome may depend on the duration of use.
The ability has several modes that cycle with each use.
The relic has reached perfect parameters. Be proud of yourself!
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.r: To unlock the ability, it is necessary to connect the stars hidden beneath the fog in such a way that the resulting constellation matches the image in the background. When the constellation is correctly aligned, the ability will be automatically researched.
Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
Hold [Shift] for fully automatic ability research.
The ability has already been researched!
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.b: Use the [%1$s] key outside any interface to call up the active abilities menu!
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.g: Earned when leveling up the relic and used to upgrade abilities.
Player experience from 'vanilla' Minecraft. Gained by killing mobs, mining ore, smelting items, etc.

Gained with each unsuccessful reroll of a relic's random attributes and increases the chance of getting better values on the next reroll. Increases the reroll cost by 5 player experience points for each percent of luck.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.r: To unlock, you need to level up the relic to %1$s!
Ability has no upgradeable stats and does not affect the quality of the relic!
To use, you need to conduct the research!
Ability is ready to be unlocked! Clicks remaining: %1$s
Ability is ready to be upgraded!
To unlock the experience source, you need to level up the relic to %1$s!
To unlock the experience source, you need to unlock and research the associated ability!

Relic quality is the arithmetic average of all currently unlocked abilities' quality and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the item's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the overall quality of the relic, each ability needs to be considered separately.

Gained by using relic abilities as intended (more details can be found on the experience sources page). Upon reaching the maximum experience value, the relic's level and the pool of upgrade points increase by 1, allowing you to unlock previously unavailable abilities or enhance existing ones.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.researching.a: Ability quality, similar to relic quality, is the arithmetic average of all the ability's current characteristics and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the ability's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the ability's quality, you need to reset its random characteristics until you get a better value.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.relic.upgrade: Cost: %1$s upgrade points %2$s, %3$s player experience points (%4$s relative levels) %5$s.
The ability has reached its max level.
Hold [Shift] to automatically upgrade to the highest possible level.
Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
Hold [Shift] to automatically reroll random stats to perfect values.
Hold [Shift] to confirm rerolling stats from perfect values to other random ones.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.relic.reset.c: Cost: %1$s player experience points (%2$s relative levels) %3$s.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.relic.reset.l: To use you need to level-up this ability at least 1 time.
A mysterious piece of meat that smoothly regenerates to its original size, no matter how much you carve it.
Every %1$s seconds, regenerates up to 6 edible chunks, each restoring %2$s hunger points. When consumed, the relic automatically uses the required number of chunks to replenish the player's hunger.

Allows applying potion effects to the relic by left-clicking it with a potion in the inventory. Each time the relic is consumed, it applies these effects to the player for %1$s seconds per hunger point restored. Using a water bottle clears the last applied potion effects.
Allows the relic to be used as a melee weapon, dealing %1$s damage and stunning the target for %2$s seconds per chunk. Consumes all chunks when attacking, regardless of the target's remaining health.
+%1$s experience points for each chunk consumed through the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each effect applied to the relic using the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each chunk consumed during the activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.enders_hand.d: +1 experience point for using the ability «End Transposition», +1 experience point for every 10 blocks from the distance to the target when using.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.enders_hand.a: Makes endermen neutral to the wearer.
Swaps the user and the target along the line of sight within a range of up to %1$s blocks.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.holy_locket.d: Grants the wearer the ability to turn enemies' healing against them.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.holy_locket.a: Has 2 toggleable modes: Holiness and Unholiness. In the red Holiness mode, steals %1$s%% of the healing from visible entities within a radius of %3$s blocks and transfers it to the relic's wearer. In the blue Unholiness mode, deals damage to all visible entities within the same radius equal to %2$s%% of the healing received by the relic's wearer.
Ignites undead enemies for 10 seconds and increases damage dealt to them by %1$s%%.
Killing a target grants the relic's wearer a temporary stacking immortality effect for %2$s seconds, up to a maximum of %1$s seconds.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.holy_locket.l: +%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability on an undead enemy that is not yet burning.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+1 experience point for each use of the «Wormhole» ability, +1 experience point for every 50 blocks to the teleportation point.
Upon use, teleports the owner to their spawn point if it is within %1$s blocks, then goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.shadow_glaive: A masterfully forged, capricious weapon. If its temper is favorable, neither horde nor legion will withstand the onslaught of its thousand blades.

Dealing damage has a %1$s%% chance to trigger a projectile that bounces chaotically between nearby targets within a 16-block radius, up to %2$s times, dealing %3$s%% of the triggering attack's damage.
Each projectile bounce from the Mayhem ability has a %1$s%% chance to spawn an additional identical projectile.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.blazing_flask: +1 experience point for every 5 seconds of flight within the scope of the ability «Eternal Fire».

Using the ability on a block creates a restricted flight zone with a maximum flight speed of %2$s blocks per second and a height of %3$s blocks. The area size depends on the amount of fire within a radius of %1$s blocks around the center, but if there is no fire at all, the zone will not be created.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.elytra_booste: +1 experience point for every 10 seconds of burning fuel when placing it in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Acceleration».

Using any combustible fuel that would work in a furnace on the relic in the inventory replenishes its internal buffer, which has a maximum capacity of %1$s units. Activating the ability while flying with elytra gradually increases the player's flight speed up to %2$s blocks per second, consuming fuel from the internal buffer.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.midnight_robe: +1 experience point for every 2 units of damage when attacking while being invisible from the «Disappearing» ability.
Grants the wearer complete invisibility and increases their movement speed by %2$s%% when the total light level does not exceed %1$s.

An attack while using the 'Vanish' ability deals %1$s%% increased damage, marking a circle with a radius of %2$s blocks around the target and dispelling the wearer's invisibility. The 'Vanish' ability can only be used again after the wearer exits the circle.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.reflection_ne: +1 experience point for every 10 damage accumulated in the internal buffer of the relic from the ability «Infernal Hatred».

Accumulates damage taken by the wearer into the relic's internal buffer, with a capacity of %1$s units. Five seconds after the last damage received or if the buffer overflows, the relic explodes, scattering obsidian shards in all directions. Each shard deals %2$s damage and stuns for %3$s seconds per unit of damage stored in the relic's internal buffer.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.jellyfish_nec: +1 experience point for each activation of the ability «Electric Discharge».
The wearer does not sink in water.
Deals %1$s damage to targets upon collision with them.
When the «Electric Discharge» ability activates, it applies paralysis to the target for %1$s seconds.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.spore_sack.de: A simple burlap sack filled to the brim with deadly miasma.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.spore_sack.ab: When the player's health drops below 50%, releases up to %1$s homing spores around them. These spores deal damage equal to %2$s%% of the player's missing health and block healing for affected targets for 5 seconds. The ability can trigger again once the player's health rises above 50%.
items.lang|relics|tooltip.relics.spore_sack.le: +%1$s experience points for each successful hit by a spore from the %2$s ability.
